overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance data reveals that space and planetary 'What If' scenarios heavily outperform standard static facts. Videos formatted around hypothetical planetary immersion or bizarre extreme environments (e.g., liquid diamond planets, burning ice, and extreme weather phenomena) command significantly higher views-per-day and stronger like-to-view ratios than older neurological, animal, or general physics facts.

winning_patterns.pattern: Hypothetical Planetary Immersion ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) generated over 1,000 and 972 views rapidly within the recent 7-day window, yielding exceptionally high engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on immersive, high-stakes 'What If' space scenarios featuring extreme planetary environments with tangible, mind-bending physical consequences.

winning_patterns.pattern: Bizarre Extreme Weather/Rain Phenomena on Exoplanets
winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing surreal meteorological conditions such as supersonic rubies (QXuqYERlqSo) and coal-dark planets (v1rrcZLdp4U) consistently drive strong organic traction.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form concepts focusing on bizarre, counter-intuitive exoplanet physics and deadly planetary weather.

weak_patterns.evidence: Content centered around memory and psychological tricks (e.g., 5AN7LUgqarc, mGEgENcGcNE, ef3ND4qiRHc) stagnated heavily, pulling under 70 views with negligible engagement metrics.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize abstract human psychology facts in favor of high-visual-potential space, science, and cinematic survival concepts.

weak_patterns.pattern: Standard Animal Trivia Without High Stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts like octopuses having three hearts (AXAfwrzzEdU) or single-fact survival trivia underperformed compared to high-production astronomical mysteries.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot animal content exclusively toward cinematic, high-stakes animal survival or extreme prehistoric comparisons rather than standard biological trivia.
